items.q: When is the cut-off for Shabbat orders?
items.a: Thursday 8 pm for that week's Shabbat. After that, the form automatically switches to the following Shabbat. For a last-minute request, message Yonathan on WhatsApp.
Yes, in Marseille and the surrounding area, on Thursday evening or Friday morning. The exact area and fee are confirmed with your order.

items.q: Where do I collect my order?
items.a: The collection point is given when your order is confirmed, together with your chosen time.

items.q: How should I store and reheat the dishes?
items.a: Refrigerate as soon as you receive them. Mains reheat on the Shabbat hot plate or covered in the oven; salads are served cold. Yonathan will tell you how long each dish keeps.
Kosher Mehadrin, under the supervision of the Beth Din of Marseille. The certificate is available on request and will be published on this page.
